annotation.authors_or_issuer: 警察庁 (National Police Agency of Japan)
key_provisions_or_claims: Public-road trials of sidewalk robots require road use permission under Road Traffic Act Article 77, with version 2.0 clarifying legged/walking robots.
Monitoring/operator must be designated, trained, hold appropriate licence, and bear driver-equivalent duties; one operator per running robot.
Size, speed and pedestrian-density limits for locations; physical separation required above 10 km/h.
Robots need emergency stop, communication-loss auto-stop, and 240 hours of prior running trials for certain categories.
Accident response, insurance, data logging, police public-road verification, and cybersecurity efforts required.
annotation.summary_en: Japan's National Police Agency standard (version 2.0, August 2026) for granting road use permits to public-road trials of sidewalk-travelling robots, now clarified to include legged walking robots. It sets criteria on operators, locations, robot construction, safety measures, permit conditions, accident response, insurance and data logging.
annotation.title_clean: 歩道走行型ロボットの公道実証実験に係る道路使用許可基準
annotation.title_en: Road Use Permit Standards for Public-Road Demonstration Trials of Sidewalk-Travelling Robots
